Summary:

NEW -Steps from Seaside - Private Pool, 4 Bikes, Golf Cart/Option - Public Beach - 2 Minute Bike Ride -Seagrove`s Pearl



The Space:

✨QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:

✔ Private Heated Pool (heat option available)– Relax & unwind in your own oasis

✔ Brand New Construction – Modern design & high-end finishes

✔ HUGE Outdoor Living Space – Perfect for entertaining & lounging

✔ 2 Living Spaces – Plenty of room for the whole group

✔ 4 FREE Beach Bikes – Explore 30A with ease

✔ Driveway - 4 Cars – Hassle-free parking for your stay

✔ Steps to the Beach – Quick access to sugar-white sands

✔ Golf Cart Option - 6-seater golf cart available for rent



🏠Welcome to Seagrove's Pearl



NEW CONSTRUCTION! Just a few steps from Seaside and the sugar-white sand you will find this beautiful home tucked away in the heart of 30A. This newly built home offers 4 bedrooms with 4 full bathrooms and sleeps up to 10 guests.



As you make your way up the front porch and into the home you will be greeted by stunning vaulted ceilings, a spacious living area, and kitchen. Having stainless steel appliances, a large stove top, and a beautiful quartz countertop island, this kitchen is a chef's dream. With a large open living space that boasts gorgeous outdoor views of the pool, it will be hard to leave this home. As you head outside you will find a screened-in porch leading you to your own private heated pool. This outdoor area is completely fenced in allowing you to have tons of privacy.



On the first floor, you will also find two king-sized bedrooms both offering en suite bathrooms and walk-in showers. As you walk upstairs you will first find the perfect spot for kids to relax and hang out. This room has several places to unwind while enjoying the large flat-screened TV. As you continue through the second floor you will see a queen-sized bedroom accompanied by a cozy bunk bed that share a very spacious bathroom. The final bedroom is a king-sized bedroom with an en suite bathroom. This room comes with views of the private pool and has a closet big enough to fit a pack-and-play.



This is the perfect home for friends and family to enjoy a nice relaxing time together. Come spend your next vacation in this beautiful home and soak in all that 30A has to offer.





House Rules

**No Pets!**

**No Smoking!**

**No Parties!**

**The primary renter must be at least 25 years old**

**No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25**

**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**





** YouTube TV and Streaming**



Pool Heat

*Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st

*Pool heat max temperature is 82 degrees

*Fee $50 per day / $350 per week

*Heating applies to the entire stay, may be added after arrival

*48 hour advanced notice required to add pool heat



*Garage and carriage house not for guest use



** 6 seat Golf cart available for RENT for $150 per day***





SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS  Main House Only:

1st floor- King-sized bed, en suite bathroom with walk-in shower

1st floor- King-sized bed, en suite bathroom with walk-in shower

2nd floor- Queen bed with 1 bunk, stand up shower

2nd floor- King-sized bed, en suite bathroom with stand-up shower



AREA ATTRACTIONS:

Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.  Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
